bed.name: Cargo bed
bed.desc: Raise the bed for access to the engine, CVT and transaxle (prop it before working under it). Daily engine oil check is done with the bed up. Wash after use, but not with brackish or reclaimed water.

bedlift.name: Bed lift and latch
bedlift.desc: Manual tip bed. Support the raised bed on its prop before reaching under it, and check the latch holds the bed down before driving. No separate part numbers recorded in the bible.

rops.name: ROPS (2-post) and seat belts
rops.desc: Check the seat belts and buckles daily and the ROPS mounts for damage. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS.

canopy.name: Canopy (accessory)
canopy.desc: Sun canopy mounted on the ROPS, shown in the Toro photo. It is an accessory: check whether the club units have one. No part number recorded.

screen.name: Windscreen (accessory)
screen.desc: Folding windscreen shown in the Toro photo. It is an accessory: check whether the club units have one. Clean with water and a soft cloth only. No part number recorded.

guard.name: Brush guard (accessory)
guard.desc: Front brush guard shown in the Toro photo. It is an accessory: check whether the club units have one. Check the mounting bolts after any knock. No part number recorded.

seat.name: Seats (driver and passenger)
seat.desc: Two-seat bench layout. Check the seat belts daily. The driver seat carries the operator-presence interlock.

steering.name: Steering wheel and steering
steering.desc: Check steering and suspension for loose or damaged parts every 100 h or yearly, and front camber and toe-in at the same time.

dash.name: Dash, key switch and instruments
dash.desc: Oil-pressure light, hour meter and key switch. The hour meter runs whenever the key is on, not only with the engine running, so hours over-read if keys are left on. A fitted telematics device must be activated by the Toro distributor (Intelli360 reports key-on hours).

hood.name: Hood and front body
hood.desc: Front body over the battery and front suspension. The engine is under the cargo bed, not under the hood.

lights.name: Headlights
lights.desc: Two headlights in the front body. Check before working in low light. No part numbers recorded in the bible.

susp.name: Front suspension
susp.desc: Independent front with coil-over shocks. Check for loose or damaged parts and set camber and toe-in every 100 h or yearly.

frame.name: Frame and step
frame.desc: Check for cracks and loose fasteners when the vehicle is on the hoist. Keep the step plate clear of mud.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre and wheel, left
tyreFL.desc: 22 x 9.50-10 4-ply (wheel and tyre assembly 147-2765; all-terrain option 104-7062). 55-103 kPa (8-22 psi) to suit load. Lug nuts 108-122 N.m (check at 100 h). Front disc brake, pads 140-2580. Repack the wheel bearings with Mobilgrease XHP-222 every 300 h: bearing nut 15 N.m while rotating, caliper bolts 47-54 N.m, hub seal 112-1690 if needed.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre and wheel, right
tyreFR.desc: 22 x 9.50-10 4-ply (wheel and tyre assembly 147-2765; all-terrain option 104-7062). 55-103 kPa (8-22 psi) to suit load. Lug nuts 108-122 N.m (check at 100 h). Front disc brake, pads 140-2580. Repack the wheel bearings with Mobilgrease XHP-222 every 300 h: bearing nut 15 N.m while rotating, caliper bolts 47-54 N.m, hub seal 112-1690 if needed.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre and wheel, left
tyreRL.desc: 24 x 12.00-10 4-ply (wheel and tyre assembly 147-2767; all-terrain option 104-7061, 24 x 10.5-10). 55-103 kPa (8-22 psi) to suit load. Lug nuts 108-122 N.m. Rear drum brake: inspect the shoes at 400 h, replace under 1.6 mm lining.

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre and wheel, right
tyreRR.desc: Hidden in this view. 24 x 12.00-10 4-ply (wheel and tyre assembly 147-2767). 55-103 kPa (8-22 psi) to suit load. Lug nuts 108-122 N.m.

engine.name: Engine: Briggs & Stratton Vanguard 2-cyl petrol (480 cc)
engine.desc: Air cooled, under the cargo bed (Toro engine PN 140-2599). Oil 1.4 L with filter, API SL or higher: SAE 30 above 4 C or synthetic 5W-30. First oil and filter at 25 h, then every 100 h or yearly; drain plug 17.6 N.m. Valve clearance at 50 h then every 600 h (B&S manual or dealer). Spark plugs (2) Champion RN14YC, gap 0.76 mm, 20 N.m, check every 100 h. Clean the cooling fins every 100 h, twice as often in dust.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Oil the gasket, hand tight then a further 1/2 to 3/4 turn. First change at 25 h, then every 100 h.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Inspect daily, replace the element every 100 h (every few hours in very dusty or sandy work). Housing 99-7120.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, filter and carbon canister
fuel.desc: 26.5 L (OM; Toro spec page says 24.6 L) of fresh unleaded, 91 RON, up to E10 only. In-line fuel filter every 800 h or yearly (disconnect the battery, arrow toward the carburettor). Carbon-canister vent filter every 200 h; check the opening is clear every 100 h. Inspect fuel lines and clamps every 400 h or yearly.

cvt.name: CVT clutches and drive belt
cvt.desc: Primary clutch 138-0094, secondary 136-6289. Check the drive belt at 8 h then every 200 h. Blow out the primary clutch every 400 h or yearly: goggles and dust mask, the dust is hazardous. Top speed is set by primary-clutch spacers (2 standard = 26 km/h); never run with fewer than 2.

startgen.name: Starter-generator and belt
startgen.desc: Belt driven starter-generator 131-8444. Belt tension 6 mm deflection with 44 N, pivot nut 88-115 N.m: check at 8 h then every 200 h. Brushes are replaced on condition.

battery.name: 12 V battery (sealed)
battery.desc: Maintenance free. Keep terminals clean and tight. Disconnect it before changing the fuel filter.

transaxle.name: Transaxle
transaxle.desc: 1.4 L SAE 10W-30, API SJ or higher. Check the level every 100 h, change every 800 h or yearly. Check neutral at 100 h (0.76-1.52 mm gap at the neutral bracket locknuts).

brakes.name: Brakes and park brake
brakes.desc: Front disc (calipers 161-1890), rear drum. DOT 3 fluid: check the level daily, change every 1,000 h. Inspect at 100 h and 200 h; replace linings under 1.6 mm. Adjust the park-brake handle at 200 h if needed. Rear shoe kit contents: confirm with the dealer (hardware kit 104-6819, adjuster kit 104-6820, wheel cylinder 114-8333).

147-2765.name: Front wheel and tyre assembly (22 x 9.50-10)

112-1690.name: Front hub oil seal (x2)
112-1690.note: Only if needed at the 300 h bearing repack.

147-2767.name: Rear wheel and tyre assembly (24 x 12.00-10)

140-2599.name: Engine assembly, Briggs & Stratton Vanguard 2-cyl 480 cc
140-2599.note: Major assembly. Toro engine PN from the bible; exact B&S model/type code is on the engine. Dealer quote.

138-0094.name: CVT primary (drive) clutch
138-0094.note: Clean every 400 h or yearly. Dealer quote.

131-8444.name: Starter-generator
131-8444.note: Brush box 119-9661 and springs 119-9660 are replaced on condition.

161-1890.name: Front brake caliper
161-1890.note: Same front kit as the Workman GTX.

107-7817: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
Champion RN14YC (or equivalent): Any auto parts / Toro or B&S dealer

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate; the engine, CVT, starter-generator, transaxle and fuel system sit under the cargo bed and are in the parts list. The Toro photo shows an accessory canopy, windscreen and brush guard that the club units may not have. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3472-284 (07235TC s/n 417440000 and up) and operator's manual 3471-396. Engine parts beyond filters and plugs come through Briggs & Stratton: read the engine plate for the model/type code.
